claims.disproof_condition: 條件：TTM 下一份 10-K／10-Q 的 Suppliers 段把鑽針寫成供應受限或交期延長；或其他板廠的一手寫出鑽針缺貨。核查頻率：每季（10-Q）＋每年（10-K）。觸發後 48 小時：更新這條 claim，重讀鑽針層讀圖的可替代性段。
claims.statement: Customer-side statement (TTM Technologies FY2025 10-K, filed 2026-02-17): carbide drill bits are among the primary raw materials for its advanced interconnect products (PCBs), and most of its raw materials are generally readily available from numerous suppliers in the open market; the filing does not say whether drill bits are among 'most'. Data center computing was 24% of FY2025 net sales. Counter-evidence to supplier claims of a drill-bit shortage, dated before the 2026 ramp.

sources.quote: TTM TECHNOLOGIES, INC. (Exact Name of Registrant as Specified in Its Charter)

We are a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, RF components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced interconnect products, including PCBs and substrates.

For advanced interconnect products, primary raw materials include copper clad laminates and chemical solutions such as copper and gold for plating operations, photographic film, carbide drill bits, and plastic for testing fixtures. Most of the raw materials are generally readily available from numerous suppliers in the open market.
The PCB industry remains highly fragmented and characterized by intense competition.
